# DLMM Bot

> Automated Meteora DLMM liquidity bot for Solana. Paper first. Burner wallet only.

Site: https://dlmmbot.com
Docs: https://dlmmbot.com/setup/
GitHub: https://github.com/CryptoGnome/dlmmbot
Railway signup: https://railway.com?referralCode=SCj9lN

## Docs

- [Easy setup (Railway)](https://dlmmbot.com/setup/easy): one service, volume at `/app/data`, public domain, dashboard wizard
- [Advanced setup](https://dlmmbot.com/setup/advanced): local / VPS / PM2
- [Full text for agents](https://dlmmbot.com/llms-full.txt): longer product summary
- [Strategy (repo)](https://github.com/CryptoGnome/dlmmbot/blob/master/STRATEGY.md): exits and risk rules

## Product facts

- Scans SOL-quoted Meteora DLMM pools, vets tokens, opens one-sided SOL LP, exits by fixed rules
- Dashboard: overview, book, analytics, activity, errors, research, wiki (strategy/ops manual), changes, settings
- Update toasts when GitHub is ahead or the bot restarts on a new build; BEHIND build pill pulses
- Errors tab streams structured runtime errors over WebSocket (copy dump / open GitHub issue)
- Token symbols show Jupiter / Pump.fun / DexScreener icons (cached in SQLite + browser)
- Overview Halt/Resume control; Changes shows risk tags on pending commits
- Auto-update on by default (PM2); Settings can require Approve on Changes before pull
- First-run setup wizard: RPC, encrypted wallet (create or Phantom import with password retype + one-time backup), paper/live mode
- Live requires both `FARMER_MODE=live` and `[exec].mode = "live"`
- Runtime config/env/db live under gitignored `data/` (repo `config.toml` is a template)
- Optional Railway `WALLET_PASSPHRASE` auto-unlocks encrypted wallet on boot
- Not financial advice; memecoin LP can lose 100%
